To choose a committee of 3 members from 10, where order doesn't matter, we use the combination formula:

C(n, k) = n! / (k!(n-k)!)

Here n = 10 and k = 3, so:

C(10, 3) = 10! / (3! · 7!)

The 7! cancels with part of 10!, leaving:

C(10, 3) = (10 · 9 · 8) / (3 · 2 · 1) = 720 / 6 = 120

Answer: 120
